subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical issues for completion isolation, fallback-lane ownership, and detached-work cancellation?
rationale: The remaining failures mix concrete bugs with product/API choices around session ownership, completion payloads, fallback cancellation, and cleanup semantics, so an automated fix lane should not choose the long-term contract alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as #86540 and #90561, then close only after linked symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Metadata-Only Completion Design
options.body: Make #96975 the canonical direction for subagent completion isolation and map remaining delivery and context-pressure reports to that contract.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Create or select one canonical tracker per lock, delivery, fallback, and detached-work root cause, then close this umbrella after every symptom has an owner.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as #86540 and #90561, then close only after linked symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest session/subagent feature-history signal and is the best available owner for the cross-cutting architecture choice.
